comparison.objective: Place the minimum number of thrusters into empty nests to make a layout symmetric about two centre lines; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Infer two-axis symmetry, select minimal pieces, and fit them into nests versus mandrel alignment, regulated hammer impact, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: A doubly symmetric layout using as few thrusters as possible versus four valid fractures, four contained tangs, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Although both include insertion into recesses, symmetry reasoning and nest fitting are meaningfully different from contact-driven fracture and recovery. Exact fit tolerances are not stated.
